summary: The gtest suite now covers more of Firefox’s media behavior, including A/V synchronization across seeking and playback-rate changes, audio clock drift, video frame dimensions, picture regions, and shutdown behavior. It also adds detailed coverage for NV12/I420 image conversion, AV1 color metadata and temporal IDs, HEVC keyframes in Matroska, HDR metadata transport, speech-recognition locales, and hardware encoder choices, helping catch regressions before they reach users.
